reason: Three Blockers, all the same recurring defect class. (1) Steps 3 and 10 mandate a test asserting 'every model id present in ~/.claude/projects today resolves to a rate' (plan:164-165, :384-385). CI runs the whole suite on ubuntu-latest x4 interpreters (.github/workflows/checks.yml, 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v') where that directory does not exist, so the id set is empty and the assertion is vacuously true. Written the way this project already writes directory reads (agents.py:60-61 returns [] when the dir is absent), it PASSES on the one machine that gates every PR. It is also non-deterministic where it does run: claude-opus-4-7 was 8,569 records on 2026-08-23 per plan:96 and is 0 today, and <synthetic> fell 62->55, so the corpus the test asserts against churns within a day. (2) Step 3 returns tokens as five buckets (plan:151) and says steps 7 and 8 render the two cache-write TTLs combined (plan:136), but step 8's done-when forbids arithmetic on token counts in loom.js (plan:354) and no step owns the 5m+1h addition. The builder either fails that gate or picks one TTL, and loom's own transcripts carry 0 five-minute cache-write tokens against 9,723,858 one-hour ones, so the dashboard would show cache-write 0 beside a cost computed from 9.7M tokens. This is the same finding round 3 raised against 779565d; the amendment named the rule in prose and did not assign an owner. (3) Step 4's done-when case 5 (plan:233-241) asserts a stopped session eight hours old yields an unknown shape, but the step's own rule includes every matched session in the sum (plan:187, OPEN-5 at :486-495) and no enumerated unknown_reason fits a stopped session with a readable transcript (plan:228-232). Reconciled the wrong way it drops real spend and locks that in with a test. Plus one High (per-worktree session counts have no reader: step 4 produces four per worktree at :205-206, step 6 aggregates only stale at :292-293, step 7 prints four at fleet level at :324-329 with no owner for that aggregation, step 8 renders none at :350-354) and four Mediums.
